What they did
One commenter said they use ChatGPT for birthday parties and virtual office parties, asking it to cover the full plan from invites to decor, games, and food. The post does not describe a longer workflow, tools, or review steps beyond using ChatGPT to generate those party-planning pieces.
How it went
The source gives no numbers or measured results; it presents this as a practical use case for getting a party plan together. It also does not say what worked poorly or needed correction.
Try it yourself
with
ChatGPT
Copy prompt
Help me plan a [birthday or virtual office] party for [person or team] on [date] with about [number] guests and a budget of [amount]. Give me a theme, a schedule, an activity list, a supplies or tech checklist, and a draft invitation message. Finish with a one-page plan I can copy and send, and ask me any questions you need first.
